title: Autoformat commit identity: take author from workflow event, hardcode bot ID
answers: how does the autoformat workflow set git commit author name and email
why is the mlflow-app[bot] ID hardcoded in autoformat.yml
autoformat commit attributed to wrong user or bot identity
change the noreply email format for autoformat commits
body:
Invariant: the 'Configure git' step in .github/workflows/autoformat.yml derives commit identity from `github.event.issue.user` (login, id, type), not from `gh pr view` or `gh api users/...` calls.
Bot branch: when `AUTHOR_TYPE` is `Bot`, LOGIN is `mlflow-app[bot]` and ID is the hardcoded verified value `191841109`. Keep this ID in sync with the real app identity; do not replace it with a lookup.
Email format: `git config user.email` must stay `${ID}+${LOGIN}@users.noreply.github.com` so commits map to the GitHub account.
The step's env block must carry only the `AUTHOR_*` values it reads; stale variables such as GH_TOKEN, PR_NUMBER and REPO were removed, so do not reintroduce API calls that need a token here.
Why: the workflow's event context already has the author, so no extra API round trip is needed, and the hardcoded bot ID is what keeps bot attribution correct.
applies: Applies to the autoformat workflow's git identity step; not to other workflows that legitimately call the GitHub API.
says: Automated formatting commits on pull requests are attributed to the wrong bot identity.
Ensure code formatting commits properly link to the verified GitHub app account.
The committer profile icon on automated formatting commits does not match our bot.
Automated cleanup commits should correctly display the pull request author as committer.
search: The autoformat workflow configures git commit identity directly from github.event.issue.user rather than making GitHub API calls, using a hardcoded ID for bot authors. When AUTHOR_TYPE is Bot, LOGIN is set to mlflow-app[bot] with hardcoded verified ID 191841109, formatting user.email as ${ID}+${LOGIN}@users.noreply.github.com for proper account attribution. The Configure git step env block in .github/workflows/autoformat.yml must only supply AUTHOR_* variables, omitting tokens like GH_TOKEN, PR_NUMBER, and REPO. This rule applies strictly to the autoformat workflow git identity step and not to workflows legitimately calling the GitHub API.
